findings.title: Embed template contains invalid Ruby
findings.description: `<%- end if %>` produces a syntax error, preventing rendering whenever an embedded topic exists. ERB compilation reproduced the failure. Replace it with `<%- end %>` and add a rendering test.

findings.title: Feed imports bypass HTML sanitization
findings.description: `PollFeed` passes external feed HTML directly into this raw-HTML import path. `absolutize_urls` does not sanitize it, and `Post#cook` returns it unchanged. Scripts and event-handler attributes can therefore become stored XSS on the forum origin. Sanitize imported HTML with an explicit allowlist before storing or rendering it, including updates.

findings.title: Embed assets are absent from production precompilation
findings.description: Neither `embed.css` nor `embed.js` is registered in `config/application.rb`’s precompile list. Production disables runtime compilation in `config/environments/production.rb:23`, leaving the new stylesheet and embedding script unavailable after normal asset deployment. Register both standalone assets.

findings.title: Relative URL conversion breaks valid article resources
findings.description: Only root-relative URLs are converted. Document-relative references such as `images/photo.jpg` remain relative to Discourse, while protocol-relative references such as `//cdn.example.com/photo.jpg` are incorrectly rewritten onto the article host. Resolve both link and image references against the article URL using `URI.join`, with tests for these cases.

findings.title: Full test execution was unavailable
findings.description: `bundle check` reported missing dependencies, including Rails and RSpec. Findings are based on source inspection and the standalone ERB compilation check, not a completed test suite.
